crossRefs.note: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains…
Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t…

translations.web: If part of their carcass falls on any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
translations.bsb: If a carcass falls on any seed for sowing, the seed is clean;
translations.kjv: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
translations.asv: And if aught of their carcass fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it is clean.
